predict.question: Your school has two groups taking a test: 20 students who pass at 80% and 80 students who pass at 20%. Across both groups combined, what is the pass rate?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Statistical conclusions depend on how data were selected and measured.
modelBoundary: Both groups give {A}%; omitting group B gives {B}%. No unit’s stipulated rate improves; selection changes whose rates count.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This exact aggregation shows selection sensitivity. It does not diagnose missingness in a real dataset.
